title: I Printed the Sprint Board History for the Standup Hero Who Did Zero

parts.text: I exported the ticket history at 9:18 a.m. before standup because Kyle had moved three cards to done during the meeting yesterday with no commits. The board tracks movers. I was twenty-six, IC, holding a laptop. I did not make a speech. I screenshared the history when he said we as a team again. The PM asked him to walk through the commits. There were none. He said pairing, off-board. Pairing still leaves fingerprints. The cards moved back to in progress. I kept my three real diffs. Standup ended on time, which is a miracle. Heroes need git. Boards are not theater if you press the clock icon. I press it. Kyle now pairs on-camera. The tickets have authors again, which is all agile ever wanted.

social.video_title: The clock icon knew who moved done — Part 1/1
social.description: No commits, we as a team, screenshare. Cards rolled back. Have you met a standup hero?
